construct: 31 adjacent same-shape siblings (a wrapping flex run), the LAST carrying a distinct paint (rgb(32, 160, 96))
why: A MONTH. This is the case the owner named: with no forward repetition rule, a month is ~200 flat nodes rather than a cell component with 31 instances. The flat emission is not, by itself, a wrong picture - so this case does NOT measure node count, it measures whether the 31st cell (the odd one, e.g. 'today') survives the walk at all. A month that draws 31 identical cells and loses the one that differs is the recognisability failure, and it is invisible to any instrument that counts nodes.

canvas.note: 31 sibling frames wrapping into rows; the 31st is a different fill

mustHave: the 31st box is a visibly different colour (green) from the other 30 (pale blue-grey)
the boxes wrap into multiple rows rather than one long line
all 31 boxes are the same size (16x16)
